description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Plugins_BannerTypeHTML' for handling HTML banner types in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for form building, content type, and banner cache modification, and references external files and functions related to banner rendering and form handling.

classes.name: Plugins_BannerTypeHTML
classes.description: An abstract class for HTML banner type plugin, providing methods for form building, content type, cache modification, and banner handling.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type identifier for the banner, which is 'html'.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the media content type, which is 'html'.

methods.name: getOptionDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the plugin type, 'Generic HTML Banner'.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing banner HTML content, including fields for HTML code, banner size, links, and options.

methods.name: preprocessForm
methods.description: Preprocesses form data before saving; currently returns true without modification.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Processes form data after submission; currently returns true without modification.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form; currently always returns true.

methods.name: buildHtmlTemplate
methods.description: Placeholder for building HTML template; no implementation provided.

methods.name: getBannerCache
methods.description: Modifies the banner cache output; currently returns the buffer unchanged.
